source: Ed4 C.4.7.3, pp.C-38 to C-39; C.7.3.2.1 Tests 1 and 2, pp.C-102 to C-104
description: The worked two-node case for the RESET RX WIN CMND direction (C-0274): the peer, the data sender, commands NEW RECEIVE LWE = its TX LWE 5; this node sets its RX LWE to 5 and acknowledges, so the peer's FSN 5 flagged TX WIN LWE passes Test 2 and is delivered; this node's own TX LWE is untouched, so its next DATA D_PDU is FSN 0 flagged TX WIN LWE.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked (Called node). At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY FSN 0 'ping' (TX WIN UWE and LWE) is delivered; ACK-ONLY RX LWE 1 at 83000. The peer (node B, sending data to us) then gives up FSNs 1 to 4, which we never received, so its TX LWE is 5 while our RX LWE is 1: a TX WIN LWE flag on FSN 5 would fail Test 2 here (C-0797). To resynchronise it sends RESET RX WIN CMND (C-0262) with NEW RECEIVE LWE set to its own TX LWE, 5 (C-0263), RESET FRAME ID 3, at 96000. Reading of C-0274: the receiver of the command sets its RX LWE to NEW RECEIVE LWE (C-0262: the command aligns the sender's TX LWE with the receiver's RX LWE; C-0269: NEW RECEIVE LWE is the new receiver RX LWE), not its TX LWE as item (15) prints (C-0265). So RX LWE 5, RX UWE 4 (C-1178), and a RESET ACK (RESET ACK 1, other fields 0, C-0266, C-0267, C-1173) goes at 146000. The state stays DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0681). At 156000 the peer sends FSN 5 'pong' with TX WIN UWE and LWE: Test 1 (arc 4 to 32772) and Test 2 (arc 32773 to 5) pass, so it is delivered and acknowledged. Under the printed reading RX LWE would still be 1 and Test 2 would fail, a FULL RESET in place of the delivery, and our TX LWE would have jumped to 5 though B never received a D_PDU of ours. At 155500 the client sent 'abcd'; at 202000 it goes merged with the acknowledgement as one DATA-ACK (C-0238, C-1128): FSN 0, TX WIN UWE and LWE set (our TX LWE is still 0, C-1122), RX LWE 6, no bitmap. The peer's ACK-ONLY RX LWE 1 at 216000 confirms it. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): the DATA-ACK transmission at 202000 (32 bytes) leaves 18 bytes of its last block, filled with a copy of its acknowledgement as ACK-ONLY (15 bytes, C-0214, C-0240, C-0369, C-0882), and 3 bytes are zero filled; every other transmission leaves too few bytes for an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU, or none, so it is zero filled.
